# ffxf_runners (Data Source)

Reads GitHub Actions runner capacity, installations, usage, and cache information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_runners" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `runners` (Attributes) Current runner configuration and usage details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners))

<a id="nestedatt--runners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners`

Read-Only:

- `cache` (Attributes) Actions cache usage and pricing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--cache))
- `concurrency` (Attributes) Runner concurrency limits and current usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--concurrency))
- `docker_cache` (Attributes) Docker cache usage and policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--docker_cache))
- `installations` (Attributes List) Linked GitHub installations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--installations))
- `month` (Attributes) Current monthly runner usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--month))
- `sizes` (Attributes List) Runner sizes and prices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--runners--cache"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners.cache`

Read-Only:

- `bytes` (Number) Current actions cache bytes.
- `currency` (String) Currency code.
- `price_per_gb_month` (String) Price per GiB-month as a decimal string.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) Actions cache usage by repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--cache--repositories))
- `repository_limit_gb_max` (Number) Maximum per-repository cache size in GiB.
- `retention_days` (Number) Cache retention period in days.

<a id="nestedatt--runners--cache--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners.cache.repositories`

Read-Only:

- `bytes` (Number) Cache bytes.
- `emptying` (Boolean) Whether cache deletion is pending.
- `entries` (Number) Cache entry count.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last cache use time, if available.
- `repository` (String) Repository name, or null.
- `repository_id` (Number) GitHub repository identifier.



<a id="nestedatt--runners--concurrency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners.concurrency`

Read-Only:

- `max_vcpu` (Number) Maximum concurrent vCPU capacity.
- `running_vcpu` (Number) Currently running vCPU capacity.


<a id="nestedatt--runners--docker_cache"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runners.docker_cache`

Read-Only:

- `repositories` (Attributes List) Docker cache status by repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runners--docker_cache--repositories))
- `repository_size_gb` (Number) Docker cache size per repository in GiB.
- `retention_days` (Number) Docker cache retention period in days.

Read-Only:

Read-Only:
